title: Come to the Christ in Tears
description: Come to the Christ in Tears in Tonic Solfa to ST. JOHN (PARISH CHOIR), doh is D: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns from the Morningland (Paisley, 1911).
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Hallelujah Metre (6.6.6.6.8.8), and this page sets them to ST. JOHN (PARISH CHOIR); any other Hallelujah Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Come to the Christ in tears, And in His hear-ing tell Thy sins, and griefs, and fears, The wants He kno-weth well; Fear not to bring a large re-quest, He gives, and gi-veth of His best.

lines: Come to the Christ in tears,
Thy sins, and griefs, and fears,
Fear not to bring a large request,
He gives, and giveth of His best.
Come to the Christ in tears:
We never ask, and sigh unblest,
He gives, and giveth of His best.
Come to the Christ in tears; —
So joy shall flood the heart;
They cannot weep who share His grace,
And see the smiling of His face.

source: John Brownlie, Hymns from the Morningland (1911)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns from the Morningland; set to ST. JOHN (PARISH CHOIR) by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
